purpose: Freeze the page-consumer List/Detail schema that Stage 3 equipment outputs must follow, using only Stage 2 semantics already admitted by Stage 3-0.

displayMetadataBoundary.policy: Stage 3-1 defines where these fields live but does not invent or backfill them. Until Stage 3-2 supplies them, schema validation treats them as explicit pending display metadata rather than data failure.

listRecord.description: Minimum card/list payload shared by general and exclusive equipment consumers.

detailRecord.description: Shared detailed payload. General and exclusive consumers use the same core blocks; admission/presentation is decided outside the semantic blocks.

mapping.maxLevel: stats.stats[*].maxLevel must resolve to 50 for current Stage 2 data

routingPolicy.directLink: A list/card consumer must be able to route directly to the detail record by equipmentId; names are display-only and never a route/JOIN key.
routingPolicy.sharedCore: General and exclusive equipment must not fork the Stage 2 semantic blocks. Exclusive presentation may add consumer-specific fields later while retaining this shared core schema.

sortingPolicy.classificationOrder: Use filterMap.groupOrder and filterMap.subtypeOrder; never raw Label numeric order.
sortingPolicy.history: siteTab and releaseGroupDate are carried as source metadata. Stage 3-1 does not invent missing exact release order inside a release group.
sortingPolicy.fallback: sortIndex may be used only as a deterministic fallback after explicit page sorting rules; it is not reinterpreted as historical release order.

textPolicy.effect: Use Stage 2 effectName/effectText as-is. Do not summarize, rewrite, merge, or infer equipment effect wording in page data.
textPolicy.richEffect: effectSegments is the rich-text representation; source newlines and highlight segments are preserved.

stage31Completion.completionCondition: Every general/exclusive equipment ID can populate all Stage 3-1 structural List/Detail fields from frozen Stage 2 outputs, with only nameKr/icon explicitly deferred to Stage 3-2.
